primary_colours.name: Deep Plum
primary_colours.usage: Primary brand colour, logo, dominant UI elements

primary_colours.name: Pale Cream
primary_colours.usage: Background, negative space, clean base tone

primary_colours.name: Light Lilac
primary_colours.usage: Tertiary accent, subtle washes, header backgrounds

brand_identity.tone_of_voice: Refined, aspirational and calm — emphasising intelligent design, natural light and considered living without hyperbole
brand_identity.positioning: Boutique residential development offering elevated, light-filled apartment living within a leafy natural setting

presentation_style.mood: Warm, sun-soaked and serene — balancing natural greenery with sophisticated interior comfort
presentation_style.lighting: Abundant natural light, soft and diffused, entering through large glazed openings; warm golden tones with no harsh shadows

accent_colours.where: Decorative styling props, cushions, artwork, feature furniture pieces
Soft furnishings, floral arrangements, linen textures
Sheer curtains, background wall tones, subtle decorative layering

presentation_style.staging_approach: Tastefully appointed interiors styled with restraint — natural materials, leafy botanical elements, oversized glazing as a visual hero; balconies and outdoor connection emphasised

design_principles: Let natural light be the primary design element in every render
Emphasise indoor-outdoor connection through glazing, sliding doors and balconies
Use the plum and lavender palette sparingly as accent, never overwhelming the neutral base
Maintain a sense of calm spaciousness — avoid visual clutter in staging
Botanical and leafy elements should appear in both interiors and exterior context shots
Typography hierarchy should be clear: Crista for impact headings, Liberation Sans for all supporting text
Positioning should always feel elevated but accessible — aspirational without being cold
